svg.title: A family member joins
svg.desc: 1. The owner creates an invitation with a role. 2. The member opens the link and sets an email and password, hashed with argon2id. 3. The consent screen explains that the owner may connect an AI agent that reads shared data. 4. The member chooses whether their records are included for the agent; the default is no. 5. Private wallets stay invisible to every other member, enforced by row level security.
